capabilities: Ask questions and search permitted notes without editing
Write, rewrite and append Markdown notes
Organize notes by creating folders, renaming and moving
Attach images, PDFs, Office files and audio for transcription
Generate images and save them into an output folder
disambiguation: Not a local or offline AI: it sends permitted note text and prompts directly to OpenAI using your own key.
extras: Desktop and mobile; the 0.7.0 release was verified only in Windows Obsidian and on a physical Android phone, with iOS and physical tablet verification not included. Tasks can run with no request limit by default, so API charges can accumulate; a request count is not a price cap. Optional conversation sync writes shared records into the vault (Yoofloe AI/Shared conversations folder) and relies on Obsidian Sync settings. Backups, drafts and results are stored locally with no automatic deletion. Historical cloud and MCP-wrapper releases through 0.3.31 are not reactivated in this release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run an AI agent over notes with your own API key while keeping control of which notes it can read and change.

relations.evidence: With Yoofloe Calendar 1.8.14 or later, choose Check Calendar connection.
With ChronoHUD 1.3.0 or later, choose date cards, timeline text, Mandalart goals or Eisenhower tasks.

summary: AI workspace that uses your own OpenAI key to research, write, edit and organize notes, with web search, file attachments and image generation.
